record_title: Pathway / annotation acquisition for MAGMA 1.10 competitive gene-set analysis
purpose: Supply MAGMA --set-annot gene sets keyed by NCBI Entrez Gene ID, matching the Entrez-keyed MAGMA NCBI37.3 gene location file used in the gene analysis.
hash_convention: canonical_sha256/canonical_bytes describe the exact byte stream delivered by the server for the URL given (the upstream release file). stored_sha256/stored_bytes describe the file actually written to disk. They are identical except where filter_applied_at_download is present, i.e. gene2go.
constraints_observed: No account was created, no login performed, no licence click-through accepted and no form submitted for any resource.
All files came from official primary sources (reactome.org, ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov, purl.obolibrary.org -> current.geneontology.org, syngoportal.org, proteinatlas.org).
Computational work only; no experiments of any kind.

files.name: NCBI2Reactome_All_Levels.txt
files.licence: CC0 1.0 Universal (Public Domain Dedication). Reactome licence page section (c) Data: 'All data in the Reactome database and files derived from that data are licensed under the Creative Commons Public Domain Dedication (CC0).' Source: https://reactome.org/license
files.description: Entrez Gene ID -> Reactome pathway ID, pathway name, evidence code and species, for ALL hierarchy levels (parent and child pathways).
files.notes: Stored unfiltered as downloaded; human filtering (species == 'Homo sapiens') happens at build time. 159,571 of 788,194 rows are Homo sapiens.

files.name: NCBI2Reactome.txt
files.licence: CC0 1.0 Universal (Public Domain Dedication). Source: https://reactome.org/license
files.description: Entrez Gene ID -> Reactome pathway mapping, LOWEST-LEVEL pathways only (distinct from the All_Levels file).
files.notes: Downloaded for completeness; the build uses the All_Levels file by default (--reactome-file switches it).

files.name: gene2go_human_9606.tsv.gz
files.release_version: No version string is declared in the file; upstream HTTP Last-Modified is the release marker.
files.licence: US Government public domain. NCBI/NLM policy: 'Information that is created by or for the US government on this site is within the public domain.' Source: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/home/about/policies/
files.description: Entrez Gene ID -> GO term with evidence code, qualifier, GO term name, PubMed ID and category (Process/Function/Component). Human subset only.
files.notes: DEVIATION FROM THE ~500 MB CAP, RECORDED DELIBERATELY: the canonical upstream file gene2go.gz is ~1.38 GB, and NCBI publishes no human-scoped equivalent (checked /gene/DATA/ and /gene/DATA/GENE_INFO/Mammalia/ on 2026-09-22). The full file was therefore fetched via parallel HTTP Range requests to a TEMPORARY location outside the project, verified (reassembled length == Content-Length; gzip decompressed to completion; upstream Last-Modified/ETag re-checked afterwards to confirm the release did not change mid-download), hashed in full, filtered to tax_id 9606, and the temporary full copy then deleted. canonical_bytes and canonical_sha256 below are of the COMPLETE upstream gene2go.gz file; only the human subset was written into the project. stored_bytes/stored_sha256 describe that stored human subset, which is what the build reads. The full file was never persisted.
files.download_method: HTTP Range, 8 parallel workers, 32 MiB chunks, reassembled and verified

filter_applied_at_download.rule: keep header lines plus rows whose tax_id column == 9606

files.name: go-basic.obo
files.licence: CC BY 4.0. 'Gene Ontology Consortium data and data products are licensed under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 Unported License.' Source: https://geneontology.org/docs/go-citation-policy/
files.description: GO ontology in OBO format; supplies authoritative GO term names and namespaces (biological_process / molecular_function / cellular_component).
files.notes: Requested via http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/go/go-basic.obo, which 302-redirects to https://current.geneontology.org/ontology/go-basic.obo (recorded as final_url). 38,092 non-obsolete terms parsed.

files.name: syngo1.3_complete_data.zip
files.release_version: SynGO release 1.3 (SynGO-1 series); archive members dated 2025-03-29
files.licence: NO EXPLICIT LICENCE STATEMENT found on the SynGO portal home, /about or /download pages as of 2026-09-22. SynGO self-describes as 'a public knowledgebase for synapse research'. Cite: Koopmans et al., 2019, Neuron. Treat licence as UNSPECIFIED rather than assuming open terms.
files.description: SynGO 1.3 bulk download: ontologies.xlsx (304 synaptic terms with hierarchically rolled-up gene lists incl. Entrez IDs), genes.xlsx (1,790 genes), annotations.xlsx (5,077 expert-curated annotations).
files.notes: Obtained WITHOUT registration, login or form submission: https://syngoportal.org/data/syngo1.3_complete_data.zip is a direct unauthenticated URL linked from the public /download page. No Zenodo-hosted official SynGO release exists (Zenodo API search for 'SynGO' on 2026-09-22 returned 11 records, none of them the SynGO consortium release). The build uses ontologies.xlsx because it carries the hierarchical rollup; annotations.xlsx deliberately does not.

files.name: syngo_background_brain.json
files.release_version: Accompanies SynGO-1 releases; no version string declared
files.description: Brain-expressed gene background set used by the SynGO-1 gene-set analysis webtool.
files.notes: Downloaded for reference only. NOT used to build any .setannot file. MAGMA's competitive test derives its own background from the gene-level statistics, so imposing SynGO's brain-expressed background here would double-count the background assumption.

files.name: proteinatlas.tsv.zip
files.licence: CC BY 4.0. 'The Human Protein Atlas is licensed under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License for all copyrightable parts of our database.' Source: https://www.proteinatlas.org/about/licence. CORRECTION TO BRIEF: the task brief stated HPA is CC BY-SA 3.0; the current HPA licence page states CC BY 4.0. HPA additionally warns that third-party-constrained data may be included and that users are responsible for checking such use.
files.description: HPA bulk per-gene table (proteinatlas.tsv, 43.1 MB uncompressed) including brain and single-cell classification columns: RNA single nuclei brain specificity/distribution/score/nCPM, RNA brain regional specificity/distribution/score/nTPM, RNA single cell type specificity/distribution, RNA tissue specificity.
files.notes: Direct unauthenticated URL from https://www.proteinatlas.org/about/download; 7.46 MB, well under the ~500 MB cap. proteinatlas.xml.gz (729.9 MB) was NOT downloaded because it exceeds the cap. NOT used to build any .setannot file: HPA is Ensembl-gene-keyed, not Entrez-keyed, so turning it into MAGMA sets would require an ID mapping step that would introduce its own losses; it is supplied as a supplementary annotation source only.

not_obtained.resource: MSigDB (Molecular Signatures Database), e.g. C2:CP:REACTOME, C5 GO collections, .entrez.gmt files
not_obtained.reason: The official MSigDB download route is registration-gated. https://www.gsea-msigdb.org/gsea/downloads.jsp renders a login page: 'Click here to register to view the MSigDB gene sets and/or download the GSEA software.' Registering was prohibited by the task, so it was not done.
not_obtained.additional_finding_recorded_for_honesty: A probe on 2026-09-22 found that the underlying bucket URL https://data.broadinstitute.org/gsea-msigdb/msigdb/release/2025.1.Hs/c2.cp.reactome.v2025.1.Hs.entrez.gmt returns HTTP 200 with genuine GMT content (786,337 bytes) and no authentication. That path was NOT used as a source: it circumvents the registration gate the maintainers put in front of the sanctioned download page. The probe response was discarded and is not part of this dataset.
not_obtained.impact: None material. MSigDB's C2:CP:REACTOME collection is derived from Reactome, and its C5 collection is derived from GO; both upstream sources were obtained directly from their own primary sites, in Entrez-keyed form, at a known release.

not_obtained.resource: NCBI gene2go.gz, full multi-species file retained on disk
not_obtained.status: PARTIALLY OBTAINED - human subset stored, full file not retained

not_obtained.impact: None for this analysis, which is human-only. Provenance is preserved: the SHA256 and byte count of the complete upstream stream were computed during download and are recorded above, so the stored subset remains traceable to an exact upstream release.

not_obtained.reason: 729,899,935 bytes, above the ~500 MB cap. The equivalent per-gene content was obtained as proteinatlas.tsv.zip (7.46 MB), which carries the brain and single-cell classification columns.
